transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-11-21
Start time: 16:00 PST
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Jordan (Redwood AE), Priya (Redwood SE), Carlos (Redwood CSM); Marta, Devon, Samir, Leah (Cedar Brook)

Summary: Quick kickoff to align on goals for onboarding, security requirements, and who does what. A lot of the call was clarification — network and registries and how we do Dedicated sizing.

[00:00] Jordan: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, um, really appreciate it. I'm Jordan Liu, I'm the AE on this account, with Priya our SE and Carlos our CSM. How's everybody doing?
[00:07] Marta: Hi Jordan, good thanks, excited to get started.
[00:09] Devon: Morning/afternoon, yeah thanks, quick intro — I'm Devon, CTO.
[00:12] Samir: Samir here, IT, I'll own the network pieces.
[00:15] Leah: Leah, Clinical Ops, I'll be helping with the use cases.
[00:18] Jordan: Great. The agenda for today — quick intros, align on success criteria, security and compliance baseline, discuss deployment options — hosted, dedicated, private — and then next steps. Sound good?
[00:28] Marta: Yep, that's what we need.

[00:32] Priya: I'll jump in on the technical bits. From a high level, Redwood provides hosted API for quick start, Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput, and Private VPC/on-prem for when you need strict network isolation. For onboarding typically we start with a hosted pilot to validate prompts and evals, then move to Dedicated if you need per-tenant performance guarantees, or Private if there's regulatory reasons.
[00:50] Devon: For Cedar Brook, our main gating items are data residency and audit logs — we need SSO integration, and KMS for key management, and an ability to retain logs per our compliance team.
[01:03] Jordan: Totally — we support SAML/SSO, RBAC, and can integrate with your KMS provider, we also produce audit logs and can map retention windows. Priya, can you cover the KMS and network options?
[01:13] Priya: Sure. For KMS we do a few patterns — customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations, or you can use our managed keys if that's easier for pilot. For Private deployments we can chain into your VPC and require customer-managed encryption at rest.
[01:28] Samir: Quick question on VPC: does Redwood require any inbound rules, or is it all outbound from our side? We have a fairly locked down egress policy.
[01:36] Priya: Good Q. For hosted API it's outbound TLS to Redwood endpoints. For Private there are peering options or we can set up an inbound proxy in your environment. There's some firewall rules for the peering, I'll share the network diagram after. (mumbles) — I'll add specifics to the sheet.
[01:50] Samir: Perfect.

[01:52] Marta: On success criteria — we want sub-200ms median generation latency for short prompts in prod, and a cost target not exceeding X — we haven't finalized the number — but we need to get rough estimates. We also want model quality to be at least parity with our current in-house model for triage workflows.
[02:08] Jordan: Understood. For the latency target, Dedicated usually helps guarantee lower tail latency. We can run benchmarks during the pilot to give you realistic RPS and latency curves. Priya will coordinate the benchmark checklist.
[02:20] Priya: Yep, we'll do a short-run bench with your sample payloads — 95th percentile, CPU/GPU metrics, and token cost estimates. For cost we provide cost-per-token breakdowns and optimization suggestions — batching, kv-cache, and quantization.
[02:36] Devon: Speaking of models, are you expecting us to use Redwood-verified open models or bring our own? We have a tuned model that we might want to keep private.
[02:45] Priya: You can do both. Hosted has a curated catalog and we can host customer models on Dedicated or Private depending on licensing. For private models we recommend Private or Dedicated with tenant isolation. There might be model licensing considerations.
[02:58] Marta: Okay. Also our compliance team is asking for SOC 2 and ISO docs and a point of contact for security questionnaire.
[03:06] Jordan: We'll send our SOC 2 report and our compliance packet. Carlos is your CSM, he'll be the security point for any questionnaires. Carlos?
[03:14] Carlos: Yep I'll own that. Send questionnaires to security@redwood and cc me, and I'll track.
[03:20] Leah: For the clinical users, we will need to limit data retention and be able to purge chat logs on request. How do you handle retention?
[03:27] Priya: We support configurable retention windows at the workspace level and can set up automated purge. For Private deployments we can adhere to your retention policy more strictly since data stays in your VPC.
[03:37] Samir: KMS provider — we use HashiCorp Vault currently. Is that supported?
[03:41] Priya: Yes, we have integrations for KMIP and some Vault flows. I'll include the Vault integration notes.

[03:46] Jordan: Let's talk timeline — customer wants an initial pilot for 2-4 weeks, then decision on Dedicated within 6-8 weeks depending on bench results. Does that align?
[03:57] Devon: That timeline works for execs. We need the bench early because procurement needs numbers.
[04:03] Jordan: Alright, action items — Priya will share the benchmark checklist and Dedicated sizing worksheet. Samir will share network constraints and Vault details. Leah will share clinical workflows and sample data (anonymized). Jordan will send pricing draft and onboarding guide. Carlos will send SOC2 and compliance docs.
[04:20] Priya: A quick note on benchmarking — it's important we run realistic prompts. If you can give 50-100 sample prompts and a few representative long-turn conversations we'll get a much better estimate. Also we may suggest quantized model variants for cost savings.
[04:36] Marta: We'll put together the prompts, but some are PHI — can we anonymize, or do you need to run them in Private?
[04:45] Priya: For PHI, Private or a dedicated isolated environment is preferred, but we can also anonymize for hosted pilot. We'll work with Leah on safe anonymization.

[04:55] Devon: Procurement asks about contract terms — any standard term lengths for Dedicated?
[04:59] Jordan: Dedicated typically on monthly or annual reserved commits. We'll send an initial term sheet and you can flag any legal asks.
[05:07] Marta: Also curious about telemetry and console — we need route-level latency breakdowns and token-level cost.
[05:13] Carlos: Redwood Console gives token-level cost, per-route dashboards, and tracing hooks. We can set retention windows for logs; I'll include screenshots in the onboarding packet.
[05:25] Samir: Are there hard SLOs for hosted customers?
[05:29] Priya: Hosted has best-effort; Dedicated has SLA-backed uptime and latency targets. For strict latency SLOs we recommend Dedicated.
[05:36] Marta: For the pilot, do we need to provision any infra?
[05:39] Priya: No for the hosted pilot — just API keys and a small integration. For Dedicated we'll need network peering and maybe a private subnet depending on the option.
[05:49] Jordan: Ok, quick run through of next steps: Jordan to send onboarding packet with SSO & KMS docs and pricing; Priya to share benchmark checklist and sizing; Samir to send network/VPN/VPC constraints; Leah to send clinical workflows; Carlos to send SOC2/compliance docs. We'll reconvene for an SE deep dive the week of Nov 29.
[06:10] Marta: Sounds good.
[06:12] Devon: Thanks everyone.
[06:15] Jordan: Thanks all — we’ll follow up with calendar invites and tickets.

Notes / artifacts shared: onboarding_guide.pdf (link note), dedicated_sizing_sheet.xlsx (link note), SOC2_redwood_2027.pdf (link note), benchmark_checklist.md (link note)

Questions asked:
- "Do you support HashiCorp Vault?" (answered yes, include integration notes)
- "What's the difference in latency guarantees between hosted and dedicated?" (answered: Dedicated SLA-backed, hosted best-effort)
- "Can you run PHI prompts in hosted?" (answered: prefer anonymized or use Private/dedicated)

Observed transcription quirks: sometimes names mis-attributed (e.g., Samir recognized as 'Sam' at around 03:40), occasional filler words preserved, and overlap when multiple people spoke.

End of meeting.
